URL: https://docs.crustdata.com/general/rate-limits
Title: Rate limits

Exact per-endpoint limits can change by plan and endpoint version. Verify active limits in your dashboard.
Default rate-limit is 15 requests per minute. Email gtm@crustdata.co for higher.

Default rate limits table (all 15 req/min):
  /person/search/autocomplete
  /person/professional_network/enrich/live
  /person/professional_network/search/live
  /job/professional_network/search/live
  /job/search
  /web/search/live
  /web/enrich/live
  /dev_platform/enrich
  /employee_review/enrich
  /social_post/professional_network/enrich/live
  /social_post/professional_network/search/live
  /professional_network/search/autocomplete

Implementation guidance:
  - Spread traffic across the minute; avoid burst-sending
  - Retry with exponential backoff + jitter
  - Bounded request queues, circuit breakers on non-critical flows
  - Monitor for sustained 429s
  - Centralize throttling in one shared HTTP client
  - Endpoint-specific concurrency/QPS controls
  - Prioritize business-critical requests
  - Cache stable results
